subject: TrustChain: Subprocessor delegation notice and DPA evidence request
messages:
From: Maya Reddy <legal@trustchain.inc>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor delegation notice: onboarding DataVault LLC

Hi Markus,

Per the onboarding terms in section 6.3 of our MSA, we are notifying Redwood that TrustChain intends to engage DataVault LLC (a US-based storage subprocessor) to provide encrypted object storage for customer access logs and transient persistence of debug snapshots. The work will be scoped to logs and diagnostics only — no model training datasets are in scope.

We are attaching the proposed DPA amendment and a SOC 2 Type II report for DataVault for your review. Please let us know if you need any additional evidence (pen test reports, data flow diagrams, encryption attestations). Proposed effective date for the change: 2026-09-01.

Attachments (stubs): TrustChain_DPA_v1.2.pdf; TrustChain_SOC2-2025.pdf; OrderForm_AMEND-TrustChain.docx

If you require an executed copy, we can send a DocuSign envelope (link below).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/TrustChain/DPA-12345
Drive: https://drive.trustchain.inc/assets/soc2-2025

Thanks,
Maya Reddy
Associate Counsel, TrustChain Inc.
legal@trustchain.inc

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reddy <legal@trustchain.inc>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor delegation notice: onboarding DataVault LLC

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. A few quick clarifying requests so we can route this internally: 

- Processing scope: please confirm (in writing) the exact data elements DataVault will store and retention policy (e.g., logs only, redaction applied, retention 30/90/365 days).
- Purpose limitation: confirm that data will not be used for any ML training or analytics beyond diagnostic summaries.
- Controls/evidence: we need the most recent SOC 2 Type II for DataVault (we have a copy attached but please confirm date and auditor), and a summary of encryption-at-rest and key management.
- Order form: we will need an Order Form amendment showing DataVault as a delegated provider and any cost/SLAs changes.
- Exec DPA: please provide the DocuSign envelope for the amended DPA or an executed PDF.

Action items (Redwood):
- I will loop Legal (cc’d) for redline review.
- Aditya will validate procurement/PO impact once we have the order form draft.

Can you confirm whether DataVault will be a subcontractor or a named subprocessor under TrustChain’s own DPA (i.e., will TrustChain remain the primary controller/processor per our MSA)? A short one-paragraph reply with the above answers is fine.

If you can get us the DocuSign link and the final Order Form by EOD 08/04 we can aim for a legal review on 08/05.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Security Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
[phone redacted]

From: Maya Reddy <legal@trustchain.inc>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@trustchain.inc
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor delegation notice: onboarding DataVault LLC

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 10:05 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. A few quick clarifying requests ...

Hi Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers below and attachments updated: 

- Scope/retention: DataVault will store access logs and debug snapshots only. Retention configurable by tenant; default 90 days. No production customer PII or training corpora will be stored.
- Purpose: DataVault will not use customer data for ML training or analytics beyond aggregated debug metrics.
- Controls: attaching the SOC 2 Type II attestation for 2025 (auditor: BrightAudit). Encryption at rest with AES-256; keys managed in HSM by DataVault/KMS.
- Order Form: attached a draft amendment that lists DataVault as a delegated subprocessor with no change to Redwood-facing SLAs or unit pricing.
- DocuSign: executed envelope for the TrustChain->DataVault subprocessor agreement is live here: https://app.docusign.com/TrustChain/DPA-12345

Attachments (stubs): TrustChain_DPA_v1.2.pdf (clean), TrustChain_SOC2-2025.pdf, OrderForm_AMEND-TrustChain.docx

We expect DataVault to be onboarded and available for production routes starting 2026-09-01 pending your signoff. If you need additional testing evidence (pen test, network diagrams) we can provide those within 48 hours.

Best,
Maya Reddy
Associate Counsel, TrustChain Inc.
[attachment: TrustChain_SOC2-2025.pdf] [DocuSign link referenced]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reddy <legal@trustchain.inc>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor delegation notice: onboarding DataVault LLC

Maya / Markus,

Thanks — I reviewed the materials you sent. Quick notes from Redwood Legal after an initial pass: 

1) DPA redlines: we will propose three edits to TrustChain_DPA_v1.2.pdf: a) explicit flow-down clause requiring TrustChain to contractually bind DataVault to the same security and audit obligations; b) tighter data deletion timelines for debug snapshots (30 days max unless customer opts into longer retention); c) carveout language clarifying liability cap does not apply to gross negligence or willful misuse of customer data.

2) Audit rights: we need the ability to request evidence of DataVault controls (SOC2 reports, penetration test summaries) and to run a vendor security questionnaire annually. Please confirm TrustChain will permit subprocessor audits or provide third-party attestations on an annual basis.

3) Order form: procurement (cc: Aditya) — the document looks fine but we need the amendment to explicitly call out the delegated provider and include a short acceptance clause for Redwood to approve onboarding in writing. Aditya — can you confirm PO/financial impact if any?

4) Next steps & timeline: Laura will circulate a redline to TrustChain by 2026-08-06 EOD. If TrustChain can accept or provide countered language by 2026-08-10 we can aim to complete legal signoff by 2026-08-12 and meet the 2026-09-01 target. If additional evidence is requested, that may extend the timeline by ~3 business days.

Please confirm you can accept audit rights and the deletion timeline proposal. Happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
